edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the Owned constructor.
msg.sender is used to index the balances mapping in transfer and transferFrom.
msg.sender is used to index the allowed mapping in approve and approveAndCall.
msg.sender is compared against owner through the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender is compared against newOwner to authorize acceptOwnership.
msg.sender is the debited account and event emitter in transfer.
msg.sender controls the allowance write that precedes the external receiveApproval call.
msg.sender must equal owner for transferAnyERC20Token to execute.
Owned constructor assigns msg.sender to owner, granting privileged rights.
transferOwnership writes the supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner as the authorization source.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner, changing privileged control.
UBUToken constructor sets the fixed _totalSupply value.
UBUToken constructor credits the entire supply into balances.
totalSupply derives its value from _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads from the balances mapping.
transfer mutates both the sender and recipient balances entries.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom mutates the from and to balances entries.
transferFrom decrements the allowance stored in allowed.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transfer invokes safeSub to debit the sender.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transferFrom invokes safeSub to debit balances and allowance.
safeAdd executes a raw unchecked addition before the require check.
approveAndCall performs an external call to receiverApproval on the spender.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an arbitrary token address.
The external receiveApproval call can re-enter approveAndCall before it returns.
The external ERC20 transfer call can re-enter the rescue function.
safeAdd operand a flows into the unchecked addition.
safeAdd operand b flows into the unchecked addition.
safeSub minuend parameter flows into the subtraction logic.
safeSub subtrahend parameter flows into the subtraction logic.
safeMul first operand flows into the multiplication logic.
safeMul second operand flows into the multiplication logic.
safeDiv numerator flows into the division logic.
safeDiv denominator flows into the division guard and logic.
transferOwnership parameter is stored as the pending newOwner.
transfer recipient parameter determines the credited balance entry.

approveAndCall tokens parameter becomes the allowance and call amount.
approveAndCall data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external call.

transferAnyERC20Token tokens parameter is forwarded to the external transfer.
